cache_impact_benchmark.cache_policy: Each pair prepopulates a separate warm workspace before timed arms. Cold and cached arms use distinct otherwise-identical workspaces. Timed arm order alternates; the cold arm still starts with an empty workspace cache. Cold and prepopulation runs start a new model process; a fully cached run skips model process startup. The OS file cache is not flushed, so this measures the application answer cache and includes normal host cache effects.
